title: Legends Mod: Core
description: The official core framework for the Legends Mod ecosystem.
body:
![Legends Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35ad68f673e8531ae1477d7d98eaa00d28da1d71_0.webp)

Legends: Core is the foundation of the Legends Mod ecosystem for Minecraft. It provides the shared systems, libraries, and framework required to run all official Legends content packs.

Install Legends: Core alongside any of the available packs to experience a growing collection of universes, characters, abilities, creatures, and adventures.
## Features
- Shared framework for every Legends pack
- Modular design—install only the universes you want
- Common animation, rendering, and gameplay systems
- Built for future expansion and custom content
